direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Refit the inspector evidence list inside the 360px panel so its neon outline and scrollbar never clip at the right edge.
Enlarge the smallest SVG job and metric labels to 11px minimum while preserving the 120 versus 80 mismatch alignment.
Add a visible focus ring to the Inspect source evidence disclosure and each evidence card linked to its SVG node.
Tighten spacing between the route-health pre-flight panel and the separate Investigation panel so both headings and statuses fit without ambiguity.
Enlarge the offline route note to 12px and keep the select at a 40px target height.
Keep the typed consent form visually attached to the selected recovery option and show the exact phrase, typed count, and disabled Accept state on one line each.
Align the three option cards to equal row heights so finish and cost metrics share one baseline.
Refit the route annotation over CELL-MILL-1 so the 70 units and 40 via CELL-MILL-1 text never overlaps machine outlines or flow lines.
Make the untracked-until-approval banner and each proposed task card fully visible within the inspector scroll region without clipping t2 details.
Remove duplication between the inspector Approve control and the single action-bar primary, leaving one primary per viewport.
Enlarge the PREVIEW: WILL GO OFFLINE label and tie it with pattern plus text to the dashed CELL-MILL-2 state before the shock is applied.
Give the machine select a stronger 2px focus ring and keep its invalidating consequence directly beneath it at 12px minimum.
Compress the scenario management row so the inspector ends cleanly above the action bar at 1366x768.
Preserve the red cross-hatched CELL-MILL-2 as the sole red element and verify no feasible route trace crosses it.
Enlarge the CONSTRAINED hatch-plus-text chip under Split available capacity to 11px for legibility.
Keep the pre-flight route-health and Investigation panels separated when the inspector scrolls, with sticky mini-headings.
Anchor the typed consent form to the selected revised option and keep the invalidated prior acceptance status visible above it.
Align the constrained Split card hatch, label, and reason text so its unavailable state reads without color alone.
Separate the 3 blocked prior tasks group from the proposed replacements with distinct headings, counts, and scroll regions so both remain readable simultaneously.
Refit the accepted-plan route annotation so MAT-ALLOY-B, 70 units, and 40 via CELL-MILL-1 clear the RECEIVING and CELL-MILL-1 bodies.
Ensure the inspector Approve control does not duplicate the action-bar Approve revised tasks primary.
Refit the three retained-evidence steps so Verify ledger, passphrase field, Seal packet, and Export checkpoint each show enabled or waiting status without vertical crowding.
Make the passphrase helper text 12px and pair its checklist state with text, not color alone.
Align the Before-After metrics 70, 35h, and 48h on one tabular baseline in the inspector header.
Add a clear completed-state focus ring and aria-current treatment to Recovery story complete in the rail.
Keep the sealed-packet status centred in the action bar as status text, with no competing primary action.
Enlarge the smallest completion check labels in the retained-evidence panel to 11px minimum.
